name: Medaro Mining Corp.
summary: Medaro Mining Corp. is a Canadian enterprise primarily engaged in the identification, exploration, and assessment of mineral resource properties across the country. Its portfolio currently includes several key projects: The company holds an option to secure full ownership (100%) of the Superb Lake property, which comprises 8 mining claims spanning approximately 2,187 hectares within Northwestern Ontario's Thunder Bay mining district. It also has an option for 100% interest in the CYR South lithium property, encompassing 52 mineral claims over roughly 2,748 hectares in the James Bay area of Quebec. Furthermore, Medaro has an option to acquire a 70% stake in the Yurchison Uranium property, consisting of 12 mining claims covering a substantial 55,934 hectares located in the Wollaston Domain of Northern Saskatchewan. Additionally, the company possesses an option to obtain 100% interest in the Darlin Li-Be Property, also situated in Quebec. Established in 2020, Medaro Mining Corp. maintains its corporate headquarters in Vancouver, Canada.
